# truenas_app_redeploy (Action)

Redeploys an app, re-reading its compose configuration, and waits for it to finish.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the application to redeploy (stop, pull latest images, and restart).
